text:
I'm sorry, that's worrying. Please **reset your password immediately** so the other person is locked out. Since your account may have been accessed by someone else, I'm escalating this to a Support Lead, who will follow up on the suspicious order and any charge for it.

To help them, please send the order number (it looks like `LF-` plus six digits) and the last four digits of the card used. Never share a full card number, security code or password.

Policy doesn't cover the order itself beyond that. If it's within 2 hours of being placed, you can cancel it free from "My Orders". Otherwise the Support Lead can try to intercept it before it ships, but that's not guaranteed.
